name: deep-study-center-desktop
description: Deep Study Center as a desktop app (Tauri shell around the bundled Python backend). See docs/SPEC.md §25.

scripts.build:backend: cd .. && backend\.venv\Scripts\pyinstaller desktop/backend/dsc-backend.spec --noconfirm --distpath desktop/backend/dist --workpath desktop/backend/build --log-level WARN
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend && tauri build
scripts.build:local: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.unsigned.conf.json
